Confidentiality

title: Parties associated with Procurement Actions, namely, suppliers/
chunk:
[Guidelines 2006 > I > 1.4 > 1.4.1 > Parties associated with Procurement Actions, namely, suppliers/]
1.4.1 Parties associated with Procurement Actions, namely, suppliers/

contractors and officials shall ensure that they maintain strict
confidentiality throughout the process.

title: Corruption
chunk:
[Guidelines 2006 > I > 1.4 > 1.4.2 > Corruption]
1.4.2 Corruption

The officials involved in a Procurement Action shall not abuse their
powers. An official who abuses one's position in a Procurement
Action to derive benefits for oneself or one's close family or business
associates, would be deemed to be engaged in corrupt practices.
Conflict of Interest

title: Officials shall declare that they shall remain without a conflict of interest
chunk:
[Guidelines 2006 > I > 1.4 > 1.4.3 > Officials shall declare that they shall remain without a conflict of interest]
1.4.3 Officials shall declare that they shall remain without a conflict of interest

throughout the process. Should such a compromising situation arise,
the official shall declare his/her interest and disassociate himself/herself
from the process.
No gifts or inducement to be accepted

title: Officials shall refrain from receiving any personal gain from any
chunk:
[Guidelines 2006 > I > 1.4 > 1.4.4 > Officials shall refrain from receiving any personal gain from any]
1.4.4 Officials shall refrain from receiving any personal gain from any

Procurement Action. No gifts or inducement shall be accepted.
Suppliers/contractors are liable to be disqualified from the bidding
process if found offering any gift or inducement which may have an
effect of influencing a decision or impairing the objectivity of an official.

title: For the purpose of Guideline 1.4 (Ethics in Procurement), officials
chunk:
[Guidelines 2006 > I > 1.4 > 1.4.5 > For the purpose of Guideline 1.4 (Ethics in Procurement), officials]
1.4.5 For the purpose of Guideline 1.4 (Ethics in Procurement), officials

shall mean any public officer or any other person who is engaged in
any activity related to a specific Procurement Action.

title: Information Systems

[Guidelines 2006 > 9 > 9.7 > Information Systems]
9.7 Information Systems

title: Large information technology and systems contracts are among the
chunk:
[Guidelines 2006 > 9 > 9.7 > 9.7.1 > Large information technology and systems contracts are among the]
9.7.1 Large information technology and systems contracts are among the

most challenging to procure because:
*
their technical content is diverse and difficult to define;
*
they are highly affected by changing business objectives,
organizational politics, and institutional capacity of the end-user;
*
they are subject to rapid technological change over the project
life-cycle; and
*
they entail mixtures of professional engineering services and supply
of diverse hard and soft technologies.

title: Two key features distinguish supply and installation of IT systems
chunk:
[Guidelines 2006 > 9 > 9.7 > 9.7.2 > Two key features distinguish supply and installation of IT systems]
9.7.2 Two key features distinguish supply and installation of IT systems

from goods procurement namely, increased supplier's risk and
complex service requirements. Together these two features increase
significantly the complexity and risk of the procurement and require
different evaluation and contracting terms. Thus, specialized bidding
documents in consultation with NPA shall be used in procuring
complex IT systems.

title: E-Procurement
chunk:
[Guidelines 2006 > 9 > 9.8 > E-Procurement]
9.8 E-Procurement

PEs if they so wish, may carry out following Procurement activities
electronically with the prior concurrence of the respective PCs.
(a) in addition to the general advertising process, publish Procurement
invitations on Web site;
(b) the bidders/consultants will be allowed to inspect pre-qualification
(PQ) applications and bidding documents, electronically or
otherwise, according to their preference;
(c) the bidders may be allowed to obtain clarifications through
electronic media;
(d) electronic submission of Bids will not be allowed.
